paragraphs.source_en: The Matsudaira people, beginning with Lady Tahara, were all driven into the third enclosure where Lady Keyōin had once lived. The main enclosure and the second enclosure were now occupied by the Imagawa army. Yet the Okazaki retainers expelled from their residences within the castle were not allowed to leave Okazaki. They were forced to rebuild homes for themselves and, astonishingly, became guards for the Imagawa troops inside the castle. Most of the senior retainers' families were transferred to Sunpu. Okazaki Castle became a fortress, and only Torii Iga-no-kami Tadayoshi was permitted to live within the third enclosure, where he was charged with collecting taxes.
